entities.name: Tudor Ulianovschi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tudor Ulianovschi is a Moldovan politician and diplomat who was Foreign Minister of Moldova between January 2018 and June 2019. Prior to that, he served as the Moldovan Ambassador to Liechtenstein and Switzerland.
